thresholds.WINDOW_YEARS: 3 summers per side: averages out one odd summer, still dates a change to about a year. k=2 doubled the false positives; k=4 lost recall and fired on the control.
thresholds.NOISE_Z: 4 standard errors of the window-mean difference; noise = 1.4826 x MAD of first differences / sqrt(2), so a steady trend is not counted as noise. Z=3 fired on the control (water 1987-88); Z=5 gives the same recall.
thresholds.MIN_JUMP: ndvi_mean 0.05 (a tenth of the area going green->bare), water_frac 0.02 (~0.7 km2 at 6 km), built_frac 0.03 (~1 km2). Floors stop very quiet series (e.g. desert water_frac, noise 0.0004) from reporting trivia.
thresholds.PIXEL_NDVI_JUMP / PIXEL_CLASS_JUMP: 0.15 NDVI (~4x the noise of a 3-summer pixel mean) / class flipped in >= half the summers: used to draw the region.
thresholds.MIN_REGION_SHARE: 0.5% of the area must show the change per pixel, else it is an area-wide shift (light, haze, calibration) with no place on a map.
thresholds.LOCAL_MIN_PATCH_HA + LOCAL_CLASS_JUMP: 4 ha connected patch whose built-up class fully flipped (0/3 -> 3/3 summers or back). The control's largest such patch at any split is 23 px (~2 ha); 2.5-4 ha all keep the control at 0. 2-of-3 flips let the control reach 111 px, so a full flip is required.
thresholds.PERSIST_MIN_YEARS: 2 (FR-22); one odd summer is forgiven, two in a row end it.
thresholds.old-level check: the k summers before the before-window must sit on the old side of the midpoint; removes 2-summer excursions (Central Park water 1986-87).
thresholds.merge: same-direction steps <= 2k summers apart with no reversal become one change (Lake Mead 2001-2021 instead of four steps).
thresholds.BURN_DNBR_MIN: 0.27 (USGS moderate severity) on the changed pixels, first summer after; plus the drop must happen within 2 summers.
thresholds.SHORE_WATER_SHARE: 0.5 of new 'built' pixels were water in any earlier summer -> exposed lake bed, water_loss (Lake Mead 2021: 42% in the before-window only, 71% over all earlier summers).
thresholds.DESERT rule: mean NDVI < 0.2 before and the pixels leaving 'built' gained >= 0.05 NDVI -> urban_growth (bare soil passes the built test; Summerlin's built_frac falls 1.0 -> 0.27 as suburbs replace desert).
thresholds.DR-6: main sensor family per year (TM if any L4/5, else OLI if any L8/9, else ETM+); flag if start or end is within 1 year of a family change.

tried: Series only, no merging: recall 3/9, Lake Mead's decline split into 4 steps, control 1 (water 1987-88 excursion), Lake Mead urban_growth 1.

+ step merging, old-level check, any-earlier-summer shoreline test, pixel-based desert rule: recall 4/9, control 0, FP 1. Willow Run and Delray invisible area-wide (their k=3 jumps are z < 3.5 and < 0.03 built_frac).
+ local built-up patches with 2-of-3 flips: control 4 changes. Full flip: control 0, recall 8/9.
Joining touching local patches of the same direction (Delray deck + plaza).
Sweep: local 2.5/3/4/5 ha -> recall 8/8/8/7 of 9, control 0 for all; Z 3/4/5 -> control 1/0/0; k 2/3/4 -> control 1/0/2.
weaknesses: Lake Mead 2023 water_gain is missed: the 2023 rise (+0.03) only undoes a 2022 low; a 3-year window mean cannot see a 1-2 summer change at the end of the record.
Short or end-of-record changes in general: a change needs k summers after it, so anything in the last 2 summers is invisible; fast-regrowing fires (grass) too.

Local patches add false positives against the gold set (11 total), though most look like real local projects (Palm Jumeirah islands, Summerlin infill, Willow Run 2022-23, Delray 2015-16). Willow Run 1986-87 'demolition' leans on the odd 1984 summer.
Local layer is built-up only; local vegetation or water patches were not tried (farm rotation makes NDVI patches noisy: Willow Run shows 270-px NDVI patches).
The 4 ha local floor was set against the control's noise (~2x its largest patch); one control is thin evidence for an unknown city.
The desert rule and the shrinking-lake rule rename changes; a real town built on a former lake bed would be told as water_loss.
Merged trends span long years (Lake Mead 2001-2021); the film may want sub-steps.
Local magnitudes are tiny in built_frac units (patch share of the whole area), so the narration must not present them as area-wide.
Region bbox maps pixels linearly to place.bbox (UTM square vs lon/lat envelope): off by at most a pixel or two.
Only 7 scored places; thresholds are physical but untested on forests, farms, snow.
